tilemaps.description: A sunlit forest clearing with soft grass underfoot and dappled shadows. Trees on the edges, small bushes scattered throughout. Feels safe and warm — good for early exploration or gentle challenges.
A shadowed stone cave with dripping water and sparse illumination. Cold blue-grey walls on all sides. Feels enclosed and tense. Good for challenge levels and concept reviews.
A vast stone castle with towering brick walls and cool grey flagstones. Battle-scarred with visible history. Wide open interior spaces invite strategic play. Good for boss-level challenges.
A compact stone dungeon cell with thick walls and minimal floor space. Every tile matters. Claustrophobic and tight — forces careful movement.
A crumbling stone courtyard reclaimed by nature — half-walls, broken pillars, overgrown edges. Suggests a lost civilization. Feels ancient and melancholic.
